title: symphyotrichum boreale
intro: Symphyotrichum boreale, commonly known as northern Michaelmas daisy, is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum boreale include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
